as_of: Evening international wrap Mon Sep 7 — US closed for Labor Day, HK/Asia finalized, crypto live

dow_jones.note: Sep 4 (Fri) close 53,414.25, -0.51%. Week -0.3%. Hot Aug jobs (+162k) briefly pressured stocks on Fed-hike fears; pared losses late. US cash markets CLOSED Mon Sep 7 (Labor Day); next trade Tue Sep 8.

sp500.note: Sep 4 close ~7,718.60, -0.37%. Week +0.1%. Recovery from the prior week's DeepSeek/AI rout held; tech firmed into Friday's close. Closed for Labor Day Monday.

nasdaq.note: Sep 4 close 26,506.99, -0.29%. Week +0.4%. Megacap AI names steadied after the DeepSeek-driven selloff; Nvidia-led tech resilient. US markets shut Mon (Labor Day).

us_markets.note: US markets closed Monday for Labor Day. Reference points are Friday's close amid a hawkish repricing (162k Aug jobs, oil spiking). Futures-led tone only; next US cash session Tuesday Sep 8.

hang_seng.note: HSI closed Mon 25,413.12, -0.93% (-237.75). Early optimism from US tech gains faded; Middle East/oil risk and higher-for-longer Fed weighed on the session close.

hscei.note: Hang Seng China Enterprises closed 8,429.73, -1.47% (-125.30) — mainland/H-share names underperformed.

hstech.note: Hang Seng TECH closed 4,527.71, -0.92% (-42.09). AI/tech sentiment stayed cautious despite firmer US mega-caps Friday.

hong_kong.note: Hong Kong closed lower Monday: HSI -0.93%, after opening higher following Friday's US tech gains; gave back as oil (Hormuz) and hawkish-Fed pricing reasserted.

btc.note: BTC ~$79,610 (-0.24% 24h) per CoinGecko. Rangebound near $79.5-80k; tracking risk appetite into a quiet US-holiday session, pressured modestly by dollar/yield firmness.

eth.note: ETH ~$2,507.59 (+0.63% 24h). Firmer than BTC on the day; ETHBTC ticking up ~0.9%; direction tied to tech/AI sentiment and oil-driven macro risk.

crypto.note: Crypto holding a tight, modestly-bid tone during the US holiday lull. ETH outperforming BTC modestly; volumes thin with US cash desks closed.

macro.us_labor_day: US equity and bond markets CLOSED Monday Sep 7 for Labor Day. CME/global futures & crypto trade. Next US cash session Tue Sep 8.
macro.august_jobs: Nonfarm payrolls surged +162,000 in August (well above ~110k consensus), unemployment steady at ~4.1%. Blowout print lifts Fed rate-hike odds — 'will they hike again?' debate dominates.
macro.oil_hormuz_houthi: CRITICAL: Renewed strikes — FT & MarketWatch report Saudi Aramco facilities hit and oil near seven-week highs as Iran increases control pressure around the Strait of Hormuz; US-Iran tanker hostilities continued over the weekend. Brent cited ~$95-96.
macro.yen: Yen surged to a 6-month high Monday with traders alert for possible BOJ intervention — notable FX stress add-on; FT flagship.
macro.fed_policy: Hawkish bias reasserting: strong jobs + energy-driven inflation lift 'will the Fed hike again?' odds; Treasury sell-off and curve pressure squeeze the weakest/leveraged borrowers.
macro.commodities: Oil bid on Gulf/Hormuz hostilities (Aramco strikes); gold/silver pressured by firm dollar and elevated yields; energy-led inflation risk remains the key tailwind to hawkish Fed bets.
macro.ai_disruption: WATCH: The prior week's DeepSeek/AI rout faded — US tech firmed Friday and Asia's AI names tracked uneasily (HSTECH -0.9%). Structural capex questions persist; UN rights chief warned AI poses 'existential risk' to humanity.
macro.india_ipo: Jio Platforms said to start marketing a record India IPO next week — notable Asia capital-markets flow signal (Bloomberg).
macro.september_watch: US closed Labor Day Monday; HK/Asia closed lower. Focus this week: US-Iran/Hormuz oil escalation (~$96 Brent), hawkish Fed repricing after hot jobs, yen intervention risk, and Tuesday's US re-open.
